claims.text: The PMO advises that the King appointed Hon. Samuela 'Akilisi Pohiva as Prime Minister 'with effect from 2nd January, 2018', and appointed eleven Ministers with effect from 5th January, 2018, among them Hon. Semisi Kioa Lafu Sika as Deputy Prime Minister. After an audience on 17 January 2018, the King appointed the Prime Minister as Minister of Foreign Affairs with effect from 19 January 2018.
claims.uncertainty: Repeats the 2 January effective date. The ministerial list and Deputy Prime Minister entry are outside this packet's role scope and are not imported as holders.
